title: with_polymorphic setting on subclass eliminates selectin/subquery loads

labels.name: inheritance
labels.description: issues to do wtih ORM inheritance, a particularly tricky area

labels.name: near-term release
labels.description: addition to the milestone which indicates this should be in a near-term release

body:
```py
from sqlalchemy import Column
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy import ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy import Integer
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
Base = declarative_base()


class B(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'b'
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    a_id = Column(ForeignKey("a.id"))


class A(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'a'

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    bs = relationship("B")

class ASub(A):
    __tablename__ = 'asub'
    id = Column(ForeignKey("a.id"), primary_key=True)

    # comment this out to fix
    __mapper_args__ = {"with_polymorphic": "*"}

class ASubSub(ASub):
    __tablename__ = 'asubsub'
    id = Column(ForeignKey("asub.id"), primary_key=True)

    # comment this out to fix
    __mapper_args__ = {"with_polymorphic": "*"}

e = create_engine("sqlite://", echo=True)
Base.metadata.create_all(e)

s = Session(e)

s.add(ASubSub(bs=[B(), B()]))
s.commit()

# no eager load
ret = s.scalars(select(ASub).options(selectinload(A.bs))).all()
assert ret
s.close()

# no eager load
ret = s.scalars(select(ASubSub).options(selectinload(A.bs))).all()
assert ret
```

the problem is here:

```py
def _entity_isa(given: _InternalEntityType[Any], mapper: Mapper[Any]) -> bool:
    """determine if 'given' "is a" mapper, in terms of the given
    would load rows of type 'mapper'.

    """
    if given.is_aliased_class:
        return mapper in given.with_polymorphic_mappers or given.mapper.isa(
            mapper
        )
    elif given.with_polymorphic_mappers:
        return mapper in given.with_polymorphic_mappers
    else:
        return given.isa(mapper)

```

fix:

```diff
diff --git a/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/mapper.py b/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/mapper.py
index b8f2a5a84..d31800e9c 100644
--- a/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/mapper.py
+++ b/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/mapper.py
@@ -2699,6 +2699,15 @@ class Mapper(
             return []
         return self._mappers_from_spec(*self.with_polymorphic)
 
+    @HasMemoized.memoized_attribute
+    def _expanded_with_polymorphic_mappers(self) -> Set[Mapper[Any]]:
+        result = set()
+
+        for mapper in self._with_polymorphic_mappers:
+            result.update(mapper.iterate_to_root())
+
+        return result
+
     @HasMemoized.memoized_attribute
     def _post_inspect(self):
         """This hook is invoked by attribute inspection.
diff --git a/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/util.py b/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/util.py
index d1dbf2263..b0cfe600c 100644
--- a/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/util.py
+++ b/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/util.py
@@ -2152,11 +2152,11 @@ def _entity_isa(given: _InternalEntityType[Any], mapper: Mapper[Any]) -> bool:
 
     """
     if given.is_aliased_class:
-        return mapper in given.with_polymorphic_mappers or given.mapper.isa(
+        return mapper in given._expanded_with_polymorphic_mappers or given.mapper.isa(
             mapper
         )
     elif given.with_polymorphic_mappers:
-        return mapper in given.with_polymorphic_mappers
+        return mapper in given._expanded_with_polymorphic_mappers
     else:
         return given.isa(mapper)

```
